evals.prompt: When a user selects 'High Priority' on a case form, we need to make the 'Escalation Reason' field required and show a warning banner. How do we implement this?
evals.expected_output: Agent uses a form script with formContext to set required level and show a form notification, registered on the OnChange event of the priority field.
expectations: Agent uses formContext.getAttribute('priority').addOnChange() or registers the handler on the OnChange event of the priority field
Agent uses formContext.getAttribute('escalationreason').setRequiredLevel('required') to make the field mandatory
Agent uses formContext.ui.setFormNotification() to display a warning banner on the form
Agent passes the execution context as the first parameter to the event handler function
Agent uses getFormContext() from the execution context (not deprecated Xrm.Page)
Agent does NOT use direct DOM manipulation or jQuery to modify the form (unsupported)
Agent may include logic to remove the required level and clear the notification when priority changes away from High

evals.prompt: We need a custom ribbon button that opens a dialog showing related records. How should we implement this?
evals.expected_output: Agent uses command bar customization with a command handler that calls Xrm.Navigation.navigateTo() for the dialog, and discusses modern commanding vs classic ribbon XML.
expectations: Agent recommends using Xrm.Navigation.navigateTo() to open a dialog (side pane or modal) showing related records
Agent discusses modern commanding (Power Fx-based) as the preferred approach for new command bar buttons
Agent mentions classic RibbonDiffXml as an alternative for complex scenarios that modern commanding doesn't support
Agent defines enable rules and display rules to control when the button is visible and clickable
Agent passes the selected record context (primary entity ID) to the command handler
Agent does NOT recommend using window.open or unsupported DOM methods to create dialogs
